conversation.text: Hey there! I'm Pesa Coach, your friendly money coach. Tell me what you've spent today in KES, like fare, lunch, or airtime, and I'll track it for you!

summary.summary: You haven't logged any expenses during this session. Tracking your daily spending like matatu fare, meals, and airtime is a great first step toward building financial discipline. Start recording your expenses next time to get a personalized budget analysis!
ways_to_save: Track daily micro-expenses like snacks and airtime using M-Pesa statements to catch small money leaks.
Set up a lock-in savings account on M-Shwari or KCB M-Pesa to prevent impulse spending.
Plan your weekly meals and transport costs in advance to avoid last-minute expensive decisions.
